label: Corticostriatal (motor)
description: Sensorimotor frontal cortex drives the putamen, the motor input nucleus of the basal ganglia.

label: Corticostriatal (associative)
description: Prefrontal cortex drives the caudate (associative striatum).

label: Corticostriatal (parietal)
description: Posterior parietal association cortex projects to the caudate.

label: Corticostriatal (temporal)
description: Temporal association cortex projects to the striatum.

label: Hyperdirect (corticosubthalamic)
description: Cortex excites the subthalamic nucleus directly, the fast 'hyperdirect' brake on movement.

label: Striatopallidal (direct)
description: Direct-pathway striatal neurons inhibit the internal pallidum, releasing (disinhibiting) the thalamus.

label: Striatopallidal (direct)
description: Caudate direct-pathway output to the internal pallidum.

label: Striatonigral (direct)
description: Direct-pathway striatal output to the substantia nigra pars reticulata.

label: Striatonigral (direct)
description: Caudate direct-pathway output to the substantia nigra.

label: Pallidosubthalamic (indirect)
description: External pallidum inhibits the STN in the indirect pathway.

label: Subthalamopallidal
description: The STN excites the pallidum, amplifying basal-ganglia output (indirect/hyperdirect pathways).

label: Nigrostriatal
description: Substantia nigra pars compacta dopamine sets the balance between the direct and indirect striatal pathways.

label: Nigrostriatal
description: Dopaminergic modulation of the caudate.

label: Pallidothalamic
description: The internal pallidum tonically inhibits the motor thalamus, the output gate of the loop.

label: Nigrothalamic
description: Substantia nigra pars reticulata inhibitory output to the thalamus.

label: Thalamocortical
description: Motor thalamus excites frontal cortex, closing the cortico-basal-ganglia-thalamo-cortical loop.

label: Corticothalamic (visual)
description: Occipital (visual) cortex reciprocally connects with the thalamus (pulvinar / lateral geniculate).

label: Corticopontine
description: Cortex projects to the pontine nuclei (pons), the first leg of the cortico-ponto-cerebellar route.

label: Pontocerebellar (mossy fibers)
description: Pontine nuclei send mossy fibers to the cerebellar cortex.

label: Cerebellothalamic (dentatothalamic)
description: Deep cerebellar nuclei drive the motor thalamus, feeding the cerebellar loop back to cortex.

label: Perforant path
description: Entorhinal (medial temporal) cortex drives the hippocampus via the perforant path.

label: Fornix (hippocampal output)
description: The main output of the hippocampal formation, arising chiefly from the subiculum, gathers into the fornix, the great arching tract of the Papez circuit.

label: Postcommissural fornix
description: The fornix carries hippocampal output forward to the mammillary bodies (Papez circuit).

label: Mammillothalamic tract
description: Mammillary bodies project to the anterior thalamic nuclei, continuing the Papez circuit.

label: Anterior thalamocingulate
description: The anterior thalamic nuclei project to the cingulate gyrus, the next leg of the Papez circuit.

label: Cingulum (to hippocampus)
description: The cingulate gyrus projects back to the hippocampus via the cingulum, closing the Papez loop.

label: Olfactory projection (to amygdala)
description: Mitral cells of the olfactory bulb project to the corticomedial amygdala.

label: Olfactory projection (to olfactory cortex)
description: Bulbar output reaches the piriform / insular olfactory cortex.

label: Stria terminalis
description: The amygdala projects to the hypothalamus via the stria terminalis, driving autonomic / endocrine responses.

label: Hippocamposeptal projection
description: Hippocampal fibers run in the precommissural fornix to the septal nuclei.

label: Septohippocampal pathway
description: Medial septal cholinergic neurons project to the hippocampus, pacing the hippocampal theta rhythm.

label: Accumbens to ventral pallidum
description: Nucleus accumbens medium spiny neurons project to the (ventral) pallidum, the ventral-striatal output.

label: Hypothalamo-hypophyseal axis
description: Hypothalamic neurons drive the pituitary via the median eminence / portal system and the posterior hypophyseal tract.

label: Ascending serotonergic (prefrontal)
description: Dorsal raphe serotonin neurons project diffusely to the prefrontal cortex, shaping mood and cognition.

label: Ascending serotonergic (hippocampal)
description: Median raphe serotonin projects to the hippocampus.

label: Ascending serotonergic (amygdala)
description: Raphe serotonin modulates the amygdala, tuning emotional reactivity.

label: Ascending serotonergic (hypothalamic)
description: Raphe serotonin projects to the hypothalamus, influencing sleep, appetite and neuroendocrine rhythms.

label: Ascending serotonergic (thalamic)
description: Raphe serotonin projects to the thalamus, colouring the sensory traffic it relays to the cortex.

label: Ascending serotonergic (parietal)
description: Raphe serotonin fibers reach the parietal cortex.

label: Ascending serotonergic (temporal)
description: Raphe serotonin fibers reach the temporal cortex.

label: Ascending serotonergic (occipital)
description: Raphe serotonin fibers reach the occipital cortex.

label: Ascending serotonergic (cingulate)
description: Raphe serotonin innervates the cingulate cortex, part of the mood circuitry an antidepressant acts on.

label: Ascending serotonergic (accumbens)
description: Dorsal raphe serotonin projects to the ventral striatum, damping reward drive.

label: Ascending serotonergic (caudate)
description: Dorsal raphe serotonin projects to the caudate nucleus.

label: Ascending serotonergic (putamen)
description: Dorsal raphe serotonin projects to the putamen.

label: Ascending serotonergic (nigral)
description: Median raphe serotonin reaches the substantia nigra, restraining its dopamine neurons.

label: Ascending noradrenergic (prefrontal)
description: Locus coeruleus noradrenaline projects diffusely to the cortex, driving arousal and attention.

label: Ascending noradrenergic (hippocampal)
description: Locus coeruleus noradrenaline projects to the hippocampus.

label: Ascending noradrenergic (amygdala)
description: Locus coeruleus noradrenaline sharpens amygdala-dependent emotional memory.

label: Ascending noradrenergic (thalamic)
description: Locus coeruleus noradrenaline projects to the thalamus.

label: Ascending noradrenergic (parietal)
description: Locus coeruleus noradrenaline reaches the parietal cortex.

label: Ascending noradrenergic (temporal)
description: Locus coeruleus noradrenaline reaches the temporal cortex.

label: Ascending noradrenergic (occipital)
description: Locus coeruleus noradrenaline reaches the occipital cortex.

label: Ascending noradrenergic (cingulate)
description: Locus coeruleus noradrenaline reaches the cingulate cortex.

label: Ascending noradrenergic (hypothalamic)
description: Locus coeruleus noradrenaline projects to the hypothalamus, coupling arousal to autonomic and endocrine control.

label: Ascending noradrenergic (cerebellar)
description: Locus coeruleus noradrenaline innervates the cerebellar cortex, setting the gain of its circuitry.

label: Mesolimbic (VTA)
description: VTA dopamine projects to the nucleus accumbens, the core of the reward pathway.

label: Mesocortical
description: VTA dopamine projects to the prefrontal cortex, supporting motivation and executive control.

label: Mesolimbic (amygdala)
description: VTA dopamine innervates the amygdala.

label: Mesolimbic (hippocampal)
description: VTA dopamine projects to the hippocampus, gating reward-related memory.

label: Ascending histaminergic (prefrontal)
description: Tuberomammillary histamine neurons project diffusely to the cortex, promoting wakefulness and arousal.

label: Ascending histaminergic (thalamic)
description: Tuberomammillary histamine projects to the thalamus, gating cortical arousal.

label: Ascending histaminergic (hypothalamic)
description: Tuberomammillary histamine projects within the hypothalamus, supporting the sleep-wake switch.

label: Ascending histaminergic (basal forebrain)
description: Tuberomammillary histamine projects to the basal forebrain, reinforcing cortical activation.

label: Mesopontine cholinergic (thalamic)
description: Pedunculopontine and laterodorsal tegmental cholinergic neurons in the pons innervate the thalamus, gating what it relays to the cortex across the sleep-wake cycle.

label: Basal forebrain cholinergic (frontal)
description: Nucleus basalis cholinergic neurons innervate the frontal cortex, sustaining attention and cortical activation.

label: Basal forebrain cholinergic (parietal)
description: Nucleus basalis cholinergic fibers innervate the parietal cortex.

label: Basal forebrain cholinergic (temporal)
description: Nucleus basalis cholinergic fibers innervate the temporal cortex.

label: Basal forebrain cholinergic (occipital)
description: Nucleus basalis cholinergic fibers innervate the occipital (visual) cortex.

label: Basal forebrain cholinergic (cingulate)
description: Nucleus basalis cholinergic fibers innervate the cingulate cortex.

label: Basal forebrain cholinergic (amygdala)
description: Basal forebrain cholinergic neurons also innervate the amygdala.

label: Corpus callosum (frontal)
description: Homotopic callosal fibers linking the two frontal lobes.

label: Corpus callosum (parietal)
description: Homotopic callosal fibers linking the two parietal lobes.

label: Corpus callosum (splenium / occipital)
description: Splenial callosal fibers linking the two occipital lobes.

label: Anterior commissure
description: Older commissure linking the temporal lobes (and olfactory structures).

label: Claustro-frontal projection
description: Reciprocal claustro-cortical link with prefrontal cortex (implicated in salience / attention).

label: Claustro-insular projection
description: The claustrum tightly interconnects with the adjacent insular cortex.

label: Salience network link
description: The anterior insula and the cingulate co-activate as the salience network.

label: Basolateral amygdala to accumbens
description: Basolateral amygdala glutamatergic input to the ventral striatum (motivational salience).

label: Septohypothalamic projection
description: The septal nuclei project to the hypothalamus, a limbic-autonomic relay.
